The pinnacle of the club season. The USA Ultimate National Championships brings together the top 16 teams in the Men's, Mixed, and Women's Divisions. This four day event will be held at Surf Cup Sports Park in Del Mar, CA.
Medical and Inclement Weather Plan
 
In the event that the fields need to be cleared due to dangerous weather events, such as lightning, there are no buildings at Surf Cup that teams can use to shelter in, nor any large stores or public buildings nearby enough that teams can walk. 
 
 
Given this, please plan accordingly and keep vehicles at the complex or nearby enough that you can get your teams off the fields into vehicles quickly in case of adverse weather.
